name: zclass_gwnode_update
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeUpdate services dirty display/child bounds, updates object and world class state, recalculates cached bounds as needed, clears the transform queue flag, and reports unsupported class IDs.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass node-update/source-cluster pass after its helper cluster is accepted.
